The '''Regatta Route''' was the racing path that the [[Spira Regatta Open]] was sailed along. It circumnavigated the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Spira/Legends|Spira]], and began and ended at [[Ataria Island]]. The Route included navigating the treacherous waters at [[the Point]], and sailing past the popular tourist destination known as [[the wreck]].
